description: List the user's saved prompts from their PromptLikeEngineer library. Optionally filter by tag, repo (`project`) or `folder`. Returns id, title, description, repo, folder, updated_at and the {{variable}} names each prompt expects. Paged: `total` is the full count, and when `has_more` is true call again with `page` + 1.

folder.description: Only prompts in this folder and the folders under it, e.g. reviews or reviews/backend

project.description: Only prompts of this repo (name, slug or id)

name: list_prompts
title: List prompts
